verdict.rationale: Smithery's docs describe deep links that auto-configure supported MCP clients to use a Smithery-listed server, a managed connection layer that handles OAuth, token refresh and credentials, and a CLI to add a server by URL and call its tools. Uplink also lets you run a private tool "without hosting it" and expose it as a Smithery connection. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a generic remote MCP endpoint URL that any MCP client can point at (the connect docs emphasize a REST interface instead), and independent or hands-on confirmation that clients reach hosted tools with zero infrastructure.
